settings.heading: Candle Care Guide
settings.intro: Follow these simple steps to get the most out of your Aura & Oak candles and diffusers.
settings.step_text_1: Always trim your wick to 1/4 inch before lighting. This prevents soot, ensures an even burn, and extends the life of your candle.
settings.step_text_2: Allow the wax to melt to the edges on the first burn (about 2 hours for our 8 oz candles, 3 hours for 13 oz). This prevents tunneling and ensures an even burn pool.
settings.step_text_3: Use a candle snuffer or dip the wick into the wax and straighten it. This preserves the scent, prevents smoke, and keeps your vessel clean.
settings.safety_text:
• Never leave a burning candle unattended
  • Keep away from drafts, children, and pets
  • Place on a heat-resistant surface
  • Don't burn for more than 4 hours at a time
  • Stop burning when 1/2 inch of wax remains
settings.diffuser_text: Flip the reeds every 1-2 weeks to refresh the scent. Replace reeds every 3-4 months. Keep away from direct sunlight and heat sources. Refill with our aroma oil drops when the liquid is low.
